connector.name: ACA - Automated Client Acquisition
connector.registryDescription: Generate on-brand content, manage leads, and run outreach across 6 channels from your AI agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at automatedclientacquisition.com over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.automatedclientacquisition.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key from ACA dashboard (Settings > MCP / API). Format: Bearer cf_live_...
